_readme: Generic staples shared by every test deck (assets/js/decklist.js).
A deck list names the packages it tops up from; each package is read top to bottom,
so the order here is the priority. The count is how many you'd run with no banlist:
the current banlist caps it when the page opens, and the next card moves up.
Edit this file once and every list follows. Run scripts/check-decklists.js after.

handtraps.label: Hand traps
cards: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
Negates a search, a Special Summon from the Deck, or a send from the Deck to the GY.
Infinite Impermanence
Negates a face-up monster; can be activated from the hand if you control no cards.
Nibiru, the Primal Being
Tributes the opponent's board once they summon a fifth time in a turn.
Effect Veiler
Negates an opposing monster's effects during their Main Phase.
Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
Destroys a monster or face-up Spell/Trap that activates its effect on the field.
Mulcharmy Fuwalos
While you control no cards: draws a card each time the opponent Special Summons from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Droll & Lock Bird
After the opponent's first search, stops all adding from the Deck for the turn.
Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
Negates an effect that recovers, revives or banishes cards from the GY.

staple-spells.label: Staple Spells
cards: Called by the Grave
Banishes a monster from the opponent's GY and shuts off its copies; protection against hand traps.
Triple Tactics Talent
After the opponent activates a monster effect in your Main Phase: draw 2, steal a monster, or strip a card from their hand.
Forbidden Droplet
Halves and negates opposing monsters, and they can't respond with the same card type you sent.
Crossout Designator
Banishes a copy from your own Deck to shut off the named hand trap for the turn.
Dark Ruler No More
Negates the opponent's monsters before a big Battle Phase.
Lightning Storm
With no face-up cards: destroys their Attack Position monsters or their Spells/Traps.
Harpie's Feather Duster
Destroys every Spell and Trap the opponent controls.
Pot of Prosperity
Digs up to six cards deep for a missing piece by banishing Extra Deck cards face-down.

combo-protection.label: Combo Protection Spells
cards: Called by the Grave
Banishes a monster from the opponent's GY and shuts off its copies; protection against hand traps.
Crossout Designator
Banishes a copy from your own Deck to shut off the named hand trap for the turn.
Triple Tactics Talent
After the opponent activates a monster effect in your Main Phase: draw 2, steal a monster, or strip a card from their hand.

board-breakers.label: Board Breakers
cards: Forbidden Droplet
Halves and negates opposing monsters, and they can't respond with the same card type you sent.
Dark Ruler No More
Negates the opponent's monsters before a big Battle Phase.
Lightning Storm
With no face-up cards: destroys their Attack Position monsters or their Spells/Traps.
Harpie's Feather Duster
Destroys every Spell and Trap the opponent controls.
Raigeki
Destroys all monsters your opponent controls.

auto-spells-warrior.label: Warrior Staples
cards: Reinforcement of the Army
Searches any Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from the Deck.

auto-spells-dinosaur.label: Dinosaur Staples
cards: Fossil Dig
Searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur monster from the Deck.

auto-spells-cyberse.label: Cyberse Staples
cards: Cynet Mining
Discards a card to search any Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster from the Deck.

auto-spells-dragon.label: Dragon Staples
cards: Dragon Shrine
Sends a Dragon monster from the Deck to the GY; sends another if the first was a Normal Monster.

auto-spells-field.label: Field Spell Engine
cards: Terraforming
Searches any Field Spell from the Deck.

auto-spells-ritual.label: Ritual Staples
cards: Preparation of Rites
Searches a Level 7 or lower Ritual Monster from the Deck, then can recover a Ritual Spell from the GY.

auto-spells-level8.label: Level 8 Draw Engine
cards: Trade-In
Discards a Level 8 monster to draw 2 cards.

auto-spells-pyro.label: Pyro Staples
cards: Bonfire
Searches any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster from the Deck.

auto-spells-beast-warrior.label: Beast-Warrior Staples
cards: Fire Formation - Tenki
Continuous Spell that searches any Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior monster from the Deck.

auto-spells-dark.label: DARK Draw Engine
cards: Allure of Darkness
Draws 2 cards, then banishes 1 DARK monster from your hand.

auto-spells-psychic.label: Psychic Staples
cards: Emergency Teleport
Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons a Level 3 or lower Psychic monster from your hand or Deck.

auto-spells-level1.label: Level 1 Starter
cards: One for One
Sends a monster from your hand to the GY to Special Summon a Level 1 monster from your hand or Deck.

auto-spells-normal.label: Normal Monster Engine
cards: Unexpected Dai
If you control no monsters: Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your Deck.

auto-spells-level7.label: Level 7 Draw Engine
cards: Sacred Sword of Seven Stars
Banishes 1 Level 7 monster from your hand or face-up field to draw 2 cards.

anti-backrow.label: Spell & Trap Removal
cards: Cosmic Cyclone
Quick-Play Spell that pays 1000 LP to banish a Spell/Trap on the field.
Twin Twisters
Quick-Play Spell that discards 1 card to destroy up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field.

board-flippers.label: Board Flippers
cards: Book of Eclipse
Quick-Play Spell that changes all face-up monsters to face-down Defense Position.
Book of Moon
Quick-Play Spell that changes 1 face-up monster to face-down Defense Position.

gy-dumpers.label: Graveyard Enablers
cards: Foolish Burial
Sends 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.
Monster Reborn
Special Summons 1 monster from either player's GY.

pot-desires.label: Pot of Desires
cards: Pot of Desires
Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards.

pot-extravagance.label: Pot of Extravagance
cards: Pot of Extravagance
Banishes 3 or 6 random face-down cards from your Extra Deck to draw 1 or 2 cards.

pot-duality.label: Pot of Duality
cards: Pot of Duality
Excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck and adds 1 to hand; cannot Special Summon that turn.

rank4.label: Rank 4
cards: Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
In Defense Position, turns monsters to Defense and negates the effects they activate.
Evilswarm Exciton Knight
Quick Effect board wipe when the opponent has more cards than you.
Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder
Goes on top of an Xyz Monster that battled and sends every other card on the field to the GY.
Tornado Dragon
Destroys a Spell or Trap on either turn.
Number 101: Silent Honor ARK
Attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster to itself as material.

links.label: Generic Links
cards: S:P Little Knight
Summoned off an Extra Deck monster, banishes a card on the field or in a GY; when the opponent activates, banishes two monsters (one yours) until the End Phase.
I:P Masquerena
Link Summons on the opponent's turn; the Link Monster it becomes can't be destroyed by their card effects.
Knightmare Unicorn
Discards a card to shuffle a card on the field into the Deck.
Accesscode Talker
Finisher the opponent can't respond to: banishes Link Monsters of different Attributes to destroy their cards.
Knightmare Phoenix
Discards a card to destroy an opposing Spell/Trap.
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World
Uses one opposing monster as material and negates their face-up monsters.
Knightmare Cerberus
Link-2 from two monsters with different names: discards to destroy one of their Special Summoned monsters.
Cross-Sheep
Link-2 from two monsters with different names: draws, revives or pumps when a monster lands next to it.
Decode Talker
Link-3: tributes a monster it points to, to negate a targeting effect.
Borrelsword Dragon
Link-4 from three Effect Monsters: can't be destroyed by battle; attacks twice and halves a monster's ATK.
Haggard Lizardose
Link-2 from two monsters with different names: banishes a monster to reset another's ATK to its own.
Saryuja Skull Dread
Link-4 from monsters with different names: summons from the hand; draws 4 and returns 3 with four materials.
Firewall Dragon
Link-4: bounces monsters on the field or in a GY, one per co-linked monster.
Topologic Trisbaena
Link-3 from two Effect Monsters: banishes monsters summoned next to it and all Spells/Traps.
Space Insulator
Link-2 from any two monsters: shrinks monsters it points to.
Linkuriboh
Link-1 from a Level 1 monster: tributes itself to zero an attacker; returns from the GY.
Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax
Link-4 from monsters summoned from the Extra Deck: untargetable, forces attacks onto itself.

pin: package id -> cards that always come first, in this order. exclude: card -> why it never goes in.
notes: card -> hover text (cards in the packages above keep their notes there). Rerun the script after editing.
